The '''Compact Utility Blade''' was a model of [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] produced by [[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Compact Utility Blade was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
